get.description: One entry per delivery (one event to one subscription) with its attempt count, status and the last response (`last_status_code`, or `last_error` for a timeout or connection error). Keyset pagination on `(created_at, id)` descending, like `GET /payments`: pass `next_cursor` as `cursor` for the next page; it is null on the last page. `limit` is the page size (1 to 100); the filters apply to every page. A malformed `cursor` is 400 `malformed_request`. Rows are kept for `WEBHOOK_LOG_RETENTION_DAYS` after they are delivered or failed.

get.description: Counts of `delivered`, `failed` and `pending` deliveries in the window [`since`, `until`) and `success_rate` = delivered / (delivered + failed), null when no delivery is final. A delivered or failed delivery falls in the window by its `updated_at` (when it finished), a pending one by its `created_at`. `since` and `until` are ISO 8601 (a time without a zone is UTC) and optional; `subscription_id` limits the count to one subscription. Computed from the delivery log, so rows past `WEBHOOK_LOG_RETENTION_DAYS` are gone.

The delivery plus `attempts`, in order: for each attempt its number, the HTTP `status_code` (null without a response), `error` (the same values as `last_error`), `duration_ms` and `attempted_at`. Attempts are deleted with their delivery by the retention cleanup. An unknown id is 404.

post.description: `url` must be http or https to a host in `WEBHOOK_ALLOWED_HOSTS`, otherwise 422 `webhook_target_not_allowed` and nothing is fetched or stored. `event_types` are payment lifecycle types only. The response carries the signing `secret`, generated by Relay; it is returned only here and never again.

delete.description: Sets `active` to false; repeating it is harmless. Deliveries still waiting are marked failed (`subscription_inactive`) without a request.
